Sam: Quick snack poll — who wants the mystery cookie box from the farmer's market? Planning to swing by at 3pm.
Ivy: yes pls. Choc chip if available.
Jon: I'll take gluten-free if they have it. Otherwise I'll pass.
Ari: can you grab oat milk for the cold brew? We're down to one bottle.
Sam: noted: choc chip x2, gf x1, oatmilk x1. I'll avoid the caramel surprise this time.
skack-bot: Fridge status: Oatmilk 1L left, Cold brew concentrate 200ml, Cookies (unknown) 0.
Ivy: also FYI there are 2 cartons labeled "Team Lunch" in the fridge since Friday. Could the owners claim?
Jon: that's mine, thanks — will pick up later.
Sam: picking up at 3:10 and leaving at reception. Leave $$ in the silver tin or Venmo @sam-venmo.
Ari: left $6 in tin.
Sam: thanks! Leaving now.
